name: Street / resort interview & "overheard question" ("what are you wearing?")

shots.visual: Phone in hand, filming a stranger or staff member (hotel desk, beach, street). Handheld, vertical, a bit messy
shots.audio_text: The overheard question as hook caption: "asked the hotel front desk what mattress this is"

shots.visual: The interviewee answers on camera (or the interviewer reacts)
shots.audio_text: Natural answer, unscripted feel: "people ask every day, it's [brand]"

shots.visual: Cutaways to the product in that real setting
Creator to camera or end card

prompts.prompt: Shoot at a resort pool/beach. Ask 20 women: "what is that necklace, it looks expensive?" Ask permission on camera, get a signed release, film 4K 30fps vertical, wireless lav on the interviewer.

paid_ads.title: Penrose Skin: Nightlife street-reaction montage (Penrose)
paid_ads.what: Night-street clips of people reacting to a man ("Before you go, what do you think of this?", "OK, that's dangerous"), then a VO: "That reaction? It's real. And it happens every time. This is Penrose Skin, a pheromone-infused body butter…" 41 s.
paid_ads.how: Shoot 6-10 real stranger reactions, add a VO explaining the product, then the offer.

qa_checklist: Hook lands in the first 1.5 s (video) or is readable at thumbnail size (static / slide 1).
Removal test: delete the product from the script. If it still makes sense, rewrite so the product is the payoff.
Matches the reference structure (same beat order and length band) before any creative twist.
Uses only real product imagery for the product; AI is for backgrounds, characters or b-roll, and is disclosed where required.
Every claim is on the brand's approved-claims list (PDP); no invented stats, reviews, doctors or customers.
Captions burned in and inside the safe zone; sound-off still understandable.
One clear CTA that matches the landing page offer.
Three hook variants delivered for the same body (test hooks, not whole new ads).
Avoid: Staged "real people" interviews that are presented as real are deceptive; if actors or AI, label it.
Avoid: Get a release from everyone identifiable.
Avoid: The question must be one a real person would ask; scripted-sounding questions kill the overheard feel.
inputs: BRAND (name, product, price, offer, audience, proof points, banned claims)
